_provenance: hand-authored. The 128-bit (32-hex) HUMAN short-form fingerprint matcher + display grouping (security review 2026-10, root cause A §7). Consumed by core jvmTest (FingerprintTest) and web vitest (fingerprint.test.ts) off this one file. `full` is the EnrollCeremonyTest reference fingerprint so the short form lines up with that suite.

match.why: the old 16-hex (64-bit) prefix no longer matches — the A2 change

match.entry: zzzz zzzz zzzz zzzz zzzz zzzz zzzz zzzz

machineFullCompare._doc: A machine-supplied fingerprint (an in-person QR, a file, Account.resealEscrowFor) is compared at FULL 64 hex; a short (prefix) match is accepted ONLY from a human-typed entry. So the 32-hex short form matches the HUMAN helper but must NOT equal the full value a machine compare uses.
